data.description:
The Wayfinder's tide table, marked where the low tide opens the wreck's lower hull.

The Low Tide Run · Battle Arena
Difficulty: ★☆☆☆☆
Chance drops: Chart of the Buried Cache 10% · Core Rot 15% · Sealed Treasury 1%
Choose one: Medicine Inro · Galley Stores · Watch Roster
Spent when the run starts. No refills between fights; once inside, you leave by winning, falling or abandoning. Claim any waiting reward first.

The Deck Warden's duty roster, with a new name at the bottom in fresh ink: yours.

The Night Watch · Battle Arena
Difficulty: ★☆☆☆☆
Chance drops: Chart of the Buried Cache 10% · Core Rot 15% · Sealed Treasury 2% (3% after the Second Watch)
Choose one: Medicine Inro · Galley Stores · Tide Chart
At the end: leave, or stand the Second Watch for more (lose it and keep only what you held).
Spent when the run starts. No refills between fights; once inside, you leave by winning, falling or abandoning. Claim any waiting reward first.

The seal of the iron reliquary chained behind the Sealwright, where the echoes the Core could not hold were sealed away.

The Sealed Reliquary · Battle Arena
Difficulty: ★★★☆☆
Chance drops: Lastlight Lantern 15% · Sealed Treasury 6% · Warden's Forge-Fists, Sealwright's Seal, The First Blade variants 2% each
Choose one: Skyglass Coffer ×2 · Sealed Treasury · Skyglass Token ×2 · Archive Chart Case ×2
If you fall: 1 Core Rot.
Steep it: use it from your inventory: 3 Core Rot → a Legendary chart.
Spent when the run starts. No refills between fights; once inside, you leave by winning, falling or abandoning. Claim any waiting reward first.

The Wayfinder's final course: the night the ship came down, as the Core still replays it.

The Fall · Battle Arena
Difficulty: ★★★☆☆
Chance drops: Lastlight Lantern 15% · Core Rot 40% · Sealed Treasury 6% · The Rotted Heading 5% (helm only)
Choose one: Skyglass Coffer ×2 · Sealed Treasury · Skyglass Token ×2 · Galley Stores ×3
At the end: leave, or climb to the helm for more (lose it and keep only what you held). If you fall: 1 Core Rot.
Steep it: use it from your inventory: 3 Core Rot → a Legendary chart.
Spent when the run starts. No refills between fights; once inside, you leave by winning, falling or abandoning. Claim any waiting reward first.

The Reliquary Seal, soaked in rot: the echoes come out in pairs, and the air clogs your seals.

The Rotted Reliquary · Battle Arena
Difficulty: ★★★★☆
Chance drops: Lastlight Lantern 30% · Core Rot 40% · Sealed Treasury 6% · Warden's Forge-Fists, Sealwright's Seal, The First Blade variants 4% each
Choose two: Skyglass Coffer ×2 · Sealed Treasury · Skyglass Token ×2 · Archive Chart Case ×2
Spent when the run starts. No refills between fights; once inside, you leave by winning, falling or abandoning. Claim any waiting reward first.

The Last Heading, soaked in rot: it runs the night of the fall backwards, and the fire follows you.

data.description:
A page torn from the Arsenal Keeper's ledger: hides, horn and the hunters' prizes, sealed below the gun deck.

The Trophy Hold · Battle Arena
Difficulty: ★★★★☆
Pays: Hunter's Chests, Common up to Legendary
Up to 5 steps: a crate (a chest and a fight), a sealed locker (a better chest and a shot at a bonus one; a harder fight and a hazard) or cut through (no fight, a hazard next). Here: lockers at every step; cut through at steps 3–4. Leave after any step.
Spent when the run starts. No refills between fights; once inside, you leave by taking your haul, falling or abandoning. Lose a fight and you leave with nothing.

What the Core leaves behind when it rebuilds an impression badly: wet timber, rotten rope and skyglass gone cloudy.

Drops: endgame Wreck 15% · Low Tide Run and Night Watch 15% · The Fall and both Legendary chart runs 40% · breaking the Archive's seal (2) · a lost Epic run (1)
Steeping: use an Epic chart from your inventory and pay 3 Core Rot. Win the fight for a Legendary chart; lose and the chart comes back, the Rot spent.

The galley still stocks a larder for a crew that does not eat. A companion that does grows strong on it.

Gives 20,000 pet experience to your active pet. It must be ready for battle, have its look generated for its current rank, and not be on a task, or the experience is lost.

A token pressed from clouded skyglass and stamped with the four-point star.

Unlocks one Skyglass variant (new look and name, same stats) of a crafted weapon you own: open the weapon, choose Variants, then Use Skyglass Token. Each variant once per player.
For: Aetherion, Thornsilver, Night's Testament, Stormrender, Oathbinder, Ink of the Void, The Unwritten, Gaea's Embrace, Warden's Bracers, Eclipsed Dawnblade, Zephyr's Whisper, Yuki's Frostbite.

Taken from the Captain on his own deck. He gave every order with it, and every order was his master's.

Unlocks Captain's Command Fan, a variant of The Unwritten (new look and name, same stats). You must own The Unwritten: open it, choose Variants, then Use Captain's Command Fan. Once per player.

Cut from what the Core Horror left behind when it finally lay still.

Unlocks Rot-Bloom Reaper, a variant of Oathbinder (new look and name, same stats). You must own Oathbinder: open it, choose Variants, then Use Rot-Bloom Reaper. Once per player.

The Foundry Warden never set down his work. Now someone else can carry it.

Unlocks Warden's Forge-Fists, a variant of Warden's Bracers (new look and name, same stats). You must own Warden's Bracers: open it, choose Variants, then Use Warden's Forge-Fists. Once per player.

The Wayfinder's last correction, still pointing at a port that is not there.

Unlocks Wayfinder's Heading, a variant of Stormrender (new look and name, same stats). You must own Stormrender: open it, choose Variants, then Use Wayfinder's Heading. Once per player.

Something new, at last. He would have liked you.

Unlocks The First Blade, a variant of Aetherion (new look and name, same stats). You must own Aetherion: open it, choose Variants, then Use The First Blade. Once per player.

The Sealwright's own seal, from the hand that buried every report.

Unlocks Sealwright's Seal, a variant of Whispering Dawnblade (new look and name, same stats). You must own Whispering Dawnblade: open it, choose Variants, then Use Sealwright's Seal. Once per player.

For walking every deck of the war-ship, and breaking the crown that held them.

Unlocks Crownbreaker, a variant of Thornsilver (new look and name, same stats). You must own Thornsilver: open it, choose Variants, then Use Crownbreaker. Once per player.

The ship's mascot, sealed in a jar. The Core tried to remember it, and this is what came back.

Open it to bind the Little Horror, a Legendary pet: while it is out, enemies deal 10% less damage, and it bites 20% harder.
Will not open while your pet collection is full.

What the crown kept for itself: Crownhold's own coffer and treasury, gathered beneath the throne.

Always: 150,000 ryo · Skyglass Token
Coffer, 1 roll:
◆ Common 69% · Skyglass Filament ×2
◆ Rare 24% · Skyglass Serum ×3
◆ Epic 5% · Fragment of the Skyglass Crown
◆ Legendary 2% · Skyglass Katana
Treasury, 3–6 rolls:
◆ Common 45% · Imperial Gold ×5
◆ Rare 35% · Rare Jewels ×10
◆ Epic 15% · Imperial Gold ×15
◆ Legendary 5% · Unobtanium ×5
